# uni rakun

> uni rakun is a product studio founded by Guillaume CRESPEL (product) and Fabien JUIF (engineering), based in Nantes and Saumur, France. It designs and builds custom software and AI-powered apps for founders, startups and small and medium businesses (TPE/PME). It uses AI coding agents to move fast, but every line is reviewed, tested and shipped by engineers: no vibe coding.

Site in French at https://unirakun.fr/ and in English at https://unirakun.fr/en/.

## What uni rakun builds

- Custom software: internal tools, client portals and SaaS shaped around a business, instead of spreadsheets and stacked subscriptions.
- AI that does real work: sorting emails, reading documents, drafting reports, planning schedules, always with a human validating.
- Solid engineering: tests, code review, monitoring and clean deployments, the habits of big tech teams sized for each project.
- Method: listen, sketch a clickable prototype, build in short tested releases, keep it running and growing.
- Technologies: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Go, Kubernetes, Google Cloud, Claude, AI agents and MCP.

## Apps built and run by uni rakun

- [Brikia](https://brikia.app): the app for construction pros. Requests, reports and quotes in one place.
- [Moovi](https://moovi.run): makes coaches' work simpler. Training plans follow pain, cycle and breaks, and land on the watch.
- [Woof](https://woof-board.sh): your AI coding agents on a kanban board. Drop a card in Ready, get back a pull request.
- [Wagle](https://wagle.sh): feature flags and remote config that AI agents can drive over MCP.
- [QRakun](https://qr.rakun.sh): real-time analytics for shareable links and QR codes.
- [Kojimo](https://kojimo.fr): the business accelerator for estate agents.
